candidate_rule: two non-promoted candidates per record: derived official-snapshot metric and explicit scope guard

scope_guards.derived_ratio: Ratios are computed from rounded monthly BDUK management-information snapshots and do not establish exact-address completion, current availability, orderability or contractual milestone performance.
scope_guards.derived_change: Percentage and percentage-point changes are deterministic arithmetic over rounded snapshots and may reflect scope revisions, resubmissions or ingestion timing; they are not parcel-level build claims.
scope_guards.continuity: Continuity classifications describe whether two rounded management-information rows can be compared arithmetically; they do not establish service continuity or availability.
scope_guards.provider_aggregate: Provider totals aggregate listed contract rows and do not represent provider-wide network coverage, exact-address availability or orderability.
scope_guards.global_aggregate: Portfolio aggregates describe the selected official snapshot rows only and are not official statistics or milestone assessments.
